recentItems.title: India’s Cockroach Party says members detained ahead of protest | AJ #shorts
recentItems.description:

recentItems.title: Navi Pillay Wins Nobel Peace Prize
recentItems.description:
South African judge Navi Pillay has been awarded the 2026 Nobel Peace Prize for her work promoting human rights and international justice. A former UN human rights chief, she has played a key role in genocide investigations, including the inquiry into Gaza.

Al Jazeera’s Step Vaessen reports.

recentItems.title: Singapore haze: Indonesia fires trigger dangerous levels of pollution
recentItems.description:
Wildfires in Indonesia have caused toxic haze across Southeast Asia, pushing Singapore’s air pollution to unhealthy levels and forcing Malaysian schools to close. More than 200,000 hectares have burned, while over 170,000 people have suffered respiratory infections.

Al Jazeera’s Jessica Washington reports.

recentItems.title: UK by-election: Labour holds Starmer’s former seat
recentItems.description:
Labour has won its first by-election under UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham. Sagal Abdi-Wali secured Holborn and St Pancras, becoming the first British MP of Somali descent, defeating a challenge from Green Party leader Zack Polanski.

Al Jazeera’s Sonia Gallego reports.
